problem: 'Two more' under the lead 'What happened to those arrested' presents them as part of the 36 arrested in the April-June 2025 operations; the source (MP0772-MP0776) does not link them to those arrests, and Rifat Bishat's alleged offence is dated 10 July 2025, after them.
